_meta.source: Draft fit rules from Banfield's fit criteria (scope, location, investment, timeframe, readiness, service requirements) and the DISCOVERY P6 evidence (free-help seekers, uncommitted callers). Every rating, service area and red flag is a guess and must be reviewed by Banfield before use.
_meta.ratings: strong = a great fit; possible = worth a call, check on it; weak = likely not a fit, or not yet. Ratings are team-facing only and never shown to the client.
_meta.criteria: Each key matches a 'criterion' on a fit question in questions.json. Every answer to that question needs a rating here; a test enforces this.
_meta.serviceAreas: Municipalities Banfield serves. A site address in one of these rates location as strong; anywhere else rates it possible so Jamie can decide.
_meta.redFlags: Combinations of answers worth flagging in the team brief. A flag is raised when every condition in 'when' matches.

redFlags.note: Just exploring and only wants a one-time consult. May be looking for free advice.
Still collecting ideas with no budget in mind. May not be ready to commit.
Already underway with a builder. Design changes may be limited; ask what stage they are at.
